issues.description: Infinite checkpoint loop when save_interval does not divide max_step or training resumes past max_step
issues.detail: In run(), the loop saves a checkpoint after each train()/valid() round. If global_step already exceeds max_step on resume, the body still executes once. More importantly, train() advances by save_interval per outer iteration; if max_step is not a multiple, the final partial iteration still saves, and on resume the same step is saved repeatedly because save_checkpoint overwrites step_<N>.

issues.description: trainer_args key mismatch: docstring says max_steps/val_interval but code reads max_step and never uses val_interval
issues.detail: The constructor docs list max_steps, log_interval, val_interval, save_interval but the code reads trainer_args['max_step'] (singular) and never reads val_interval. log_interval is also stored but unused. Either the docstring or config keys are wrong; users following the documented schema will get KeyError on max_steps.

issues.description: torch.cuda.set_device called with args.local_rank which can be None
issues.detail: args.local_rank defaults to None and is only set by the launcher. When launched in environments that use env vars (LOCAL_RANK) instead of --local_rank, set_device(None) will raise. Should read from env var as fallback, or assert it is set before calling cuda.set_device.

issues.description: Validation averaging is unweighted across batches of unequal size
issues.detail: valid() collects per-batch stats and averages by simple mean over batches. If batches differ in token/sample counts (typical with batchfy by length), the resulting metric is biased. Loss/accuracy should be weighted by batch size or token count, otherwise reported val metrics are misleading.

issues.description: Validation loader uses rank/world_size sharding but results are not all-reduced across ranks for batch counts
issues.detail: Different ranks may see different numbers of validation batches, so sum/len averaging diverges per rank, and wandb is logged only on rank 0 with rank-0 batch count. The all_reduce on per-batch stats averages tensors but not the local average, producing inconsistent global validation metrics.

issues.description: Split on whitespace prevents multi-word or quoted specifiers and silently drops empty input
issues.detail: args.valid_unregistered_specifier.split() works for empty string but silently makes specifiers with embedded spaces unusable, and any user-provided comma/newline separation will be parsed wrong. Document the expected separator and validate; otherwise misconfigured runs silently produce zero validation factories.

review.summary: The PR adds a DeepSpeed trainer launcher and trainer class for SpeechLM. The most pressing issues are a docstring/config key mismatch (max_steps vs max_step, unused val_interval), a brittle local_rank handling that breaks under env-based launchers, and a checkpointing/main-loop structure that can loop or overwrite incorrectly when max_step is not aligned to save_interval. Validation metric aggregation is also statistically incorrect — unweighted mean over per-rank batches produces biased and inconsistent numbers. Several smaller correctness/usability nits (specifier parsing, unused log_interval) should be cleaned up before merge.
